channel.title: ZeroErrorEnglishPro — English Grammar for Competitive Exams
channel.description: Taught through the mistakes examiners bank on. Prepared by 22-year grammar educator.

item.title: Phrase vs Clause: What's the Difference and Why It Matters in Exams
item.description: Phrases and clauses look similar but examiners test them very differently. Learn the one-second Subject+Verb Test that tells them apart every time — built for SSC CGL and Bank exams.

item.title: Relative Clauses in English Grammar: Who, Which, That Rules Explained
item.description: Who, which, that, whom, whose — one wrong relative pronoun is one of the most repeated Error Spotting traps in SSC and Bank exams. Learn the exact rule for each in under 8 minutes.

item.title: Noun Clause vs Adjective Clause vs Adverb Clause: The 10-Second Identification System That Saves Marks
item.description: Stop losing marks on clause identification. Learn the exact Question Test method that separates Noun, Adjective and Adverb clauses in under 10 seconds — built for SSC CGL and Bank exams.

item.title: Present Perfect vs. Past Simple: The Time-Marker Trap That Costs You 2.5 Marks in Every Exam
item.description: Stop translating directly from your native language. Learn why words like 'yesterday', 'ago', and 'in 2020' strictly forbid the Present Perfect tense in SSC and banking question sets.

item.title: Subject-Verb Agreement: The 7 Traps SSC & Banking Examiners Bank On
item.description: Why do candidates who know the basic rules still lose 2.5 marks in error spotting? Discover how examiners disguise plural intervening phrases, invert clauses, and manipulate proximity.
